unlisted_practices: Contextual inquiry and workflow analysis with clinicians and caregivers to derive design requirements for an AI-based CDS tool
Embedding CDS outputs in the EHR at key points in the clinical encounter
Providing caregiver-facing educational materials alongside AI outputs

screen.reason: This is a qualitative contextual inquiry study eliciting clinician and caregiver needs and design preferences for deploying an EHR-based AI CDS tool for autism screening; it does not test a specific safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
